Use case: ui-mockup. Create realistic, production-quality UI designs with clear hierarchy, strong typography, intentional imagery, and purposeful spacing. One flat desktop web application screenshot, target 1440 x 1024 px, no device/browser frame, no multiple screens or moodboard. Chinese product “同路” for friends organizing a graduation trip. Four navigation items only 小队 / 方案 / 日程 / 账本. This is an actual working planning application, not a marketing page. Design a focused primary screen, not a feature inventory; one clear primary action with at most two supporting areas. Use generous space, grouping, alignment, typography before borders; shadows last and very subtle. No cards within cards, no decorative dashboard metrics or invented features. Readable clean modern Chinese sans serif typography, 15–16px body, 32–40px heading, maximum two typefaces; polished tabular money, exact clear Chinese labels. Existing screenshot is functional reference only: preserve product functionality but completely redesign appearance, layout, typography and imagery. Avoid old dark forest-green sidebar, beige UI, Songti/SimSun, stamp logos, pixel illustrations, microcopy clutter. Local browser-only data, no login, no live collaboration, no real-time rates, no booking, payment or AI chat. Small honest labels 示例 / 本地保存, and 估算 when relevant. Images are decorative only, no text/buttons/amounts baked into scenery. Generated scenery labeled 示意图. Current date anchor 2026-11-19 Asia/Shanghai; preserve source trip 2026-12-18 through 12-20, future illustrative dates. Landscape references grounded in real Chinese geography. Deliver a refined coherent UI ready for a product design review.
Concept name: 轻快校园. A truly different contemporary young travel-product visual system, crisp pale-lavender #F7F6FC background, deep navy #23283D text, violet #6654D9 accent, small buttery yellow #FFE79B and sky blue details. Sophisticated playful with restraint, not childish. Broad whitespace, clean 16px Chinese sans-serif, confident 40px semibold headings, 16px radius standalone objects, clean vectorlike linear Lucide icons. Narrow light 164px sidebar with small 同路 wordmark and four navigation items, 小队 selected violet, no dark slab. Thin utility bar trip switch, 示例, 本地保存, small 分享 text action. No clock or today timestamp. Only one saturated button.
Screen 小队. Friendly small upper heading “小队” with 6 人 and quiet 6/6资料齐全. Top right main 添加成员 button violet, 导入反馈 text link. Members presented as a 3-column x 2-row grid of six individual profile objects, each a genuinely separate person, open pale-white surface with ultra-light outline, no nested cards. Member grid occupies central x220–1100, y240–850. Each has 48px circle monogram at upper left, name next, a tiny ellipsis top right, clear budget as visual focal point 28px “¥1,500” and label 预算上限 below, then two compact metadata lines city and date window, one preference chip. Names/values exact: 林知夏 上海 ¥1,500 海边; 陈亦舟 杭州 ¥1,800 人文; 周予安 南京 ¥1,600 城市; 沈乐瑶 上海 ¥2,000 自然; 顾北辰 杭州 ¥2,600 自然; 苏晚晴 南京 ¥3,000 人文. Date windows12.18–12.20 all for this simplified example. To the right narrow 230px open complementary panel, one polished small isometric clay illustration of a yellow backpack, cobalt suitcase and folded travel map, detailed professional soft-shaded 3D still-life, NOT emoji, not giant mascot, no dotted decorative trail. Below artwork clean “共同日期” with “12.18 — 12.20” and 查看方案 →. Art takes <=12% of overall frame. No photos of people, no fake online badges, no slogans, no invitation mega-banner. Everything looks refined, approachable and realistically implementable.

Concept name 轻快校园. Reference1 existing plans functionality only; reference2 NEW campus visual direction to extend: pale lavender #F7F6FC, deep navy ink, violet #6654D9, buttery yellow and sky accents, narrow light sidebar164px, playful professional subtle three-dimensional destination illustrations, large clean sans serif, thin lines,16px radius. Create a fresh comparison experience based on compact horizontal destination records plus a clearly aligned constraint matrix.
Screen heading 方案, small7个候选 ·2个全员可行; single violet primary 生成方案 top right. Below compact date controls 2026.12.18 /3天2晚 /调整日期, necessary disclosure 内置估算，非实时报价. Main area one open comparison table, three large horizontal records (each y200px): each row left square200px refined isometric clay/posterlike destination artwork on matching lightly tinted background, center city plus date and large cost, right compact stacked constraint indicators and opinions. Suzhou miniature white-wall-black-roof canal bridge, Qingdao red-roof coastline blue sea, Xiamen island lighthouse/coastal architecture. Highly polished contemporary 3D papercraft imagery, no old pixel art, no mascots, no emoji; label each 示意图, no text over scenery other than disclosure.
Record1 苏州;12.18–12.20;¥960–1,020/人; 时间6/6 and预算6/6 with green check + text; 意向 赞成2·待反馈4; 查看方案→.
Record2 青岛;¥1,440–1,510/人;时间6/6预算6/6;赞成3·可接受2·待反馈1;查看方案→.
Record3 厦门;¥1,855–1,935/人;时间6/6预算3/6;amber warning3人超预算;待反馈6;查看方案→.
Aligned vertical columns and enough breathing room; show all3 at once. Colored progress or mini indicators only where they encode these true numeric constraints; no arbitrary match percentages. No duplicate card outer wrapper. Main content 1180px wide; simple local application that feels youthful, delightful, refined. Preserve essential estimate distinction, no fake vote success or forced majority confirmation.

Match ref2 narrow164px light sidebar, lavender#F7F6FC, navy ink, violet#6654D9, small buttery-yellow/sky details, sophisticated friendly16px-radius design, excellent readable Chinese sans serif. 日程 selected. Top 一起去毕业旅行 · 示例, local-storage icon 本地保存, quiet 分享. No duplicate 示例, no clock, no cloud-saved claim. One primary violet 添加安排.
Screen 日程 with date2026.12.18—12.20 ·3天. Distinct THREE-DAY SIDE-BY-SIDE COLUMN OVERVIEW. Across main width x220–1410, three day columns, separated with open whitespace and thin vertical lines, NOT huge nested cards. Each day header has 第1天 /第2天 /第3天 and date12.18 /12.19 /12.20. Tiny consistent clay-style travel illustration at top of each column, max130x110px, tasteful related objects: little navy train, beach parasol yellow/blue, violet suitcase with map; no literal location needed, no emoji, no oversized mascots.
Each column owns its schedule as airy two or one entries with tiny timeline dots, pale surface only on independent ACTIVITY if needed, not every text block.
Day1:09:30–11:00 抵达与集合,交通 ·已含于方案;14:00–16:30 老城区漫步,活动 ·¥0/人. Day2:未定时间 海滨浴场半日,活动 ·¥45/人;17:30–19:00 海鲜大餐,餐饮 ·已含于方案. Day3:未定时间 返程前自由活动,其他 ·待估算 with gentle amber icon. Each activity has compact ellipsis in upperright, no giant repeated edit buttons. Keep order source respecting untimed placement but don't invent time. No drag handles or drag-and-drop claims, just real edit menu. No interactive maps/route optimizer/weather. At bottom below columns, one slim full-width inline budget band: 全程活动估算 ¥45/人 已知部分 |1项待估算 |2项已含于方案 |方案基准待确认. No extra statistics cards. Plenty of quiet area below sparse day3, do not fill with prose or decoration. Key action and full trip overview legible in one viewport. Contemporary understated joyful polished UI.
